fields.value: Torvec may cancel participation in referenced events in its sole discretion by notifying Vendor at least two weeks before the payment due date(s); no general termination-for-convenience right is stated.

quotes.text:
The schedule set forth in Exhibit A will constitute invoicing for the events. Notwithstanding the above, Torvec may, in its sole
discretion, cancel its participation in any of the above-referenced events by notifying Vendor of such cancellation not later than two weeks
prior to the due date(s) for payment hereunder. All checks shall be made payabe to: Phoenix Performance, LLC and mailed to 481, Schuylkill
Rd, Phoenixville, Pa. 19460.

ambiguities: Clause 5 permits Torvec to cancel participation in events, not expressly to terminate the entire Agreement.
Clause 5 measures the notice period from payment due date(s), but Exhibit A with those due dates is not included in the supplied text.

fields.value: Either party may terminate immediately for specified bankruptcy/insolvency-related events; the non-assigning party may immediately cancel and terminate for an attempted assignment without consent.

quotes.text:
Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other party (i) files a petition commencing a voluntary case under the
Bankruptcy Code; (ii) makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors; (iii) admits in writing its inability to pay its debts as they become
due; (iv) seeks, consents to or acquiesces in the appointment of any trustee, receiver or liquidator of it or any part of its property; or (v) has
commenced against it an involuntary case under the Bankruptcy Code or a proceeding under any receivership, composition, readjustment,
liquidation, insolvency, dissolution or like law or statute, which case or proceeding is not dismissed or vacated within sixty (60) days.

Any attempt to assign without the other party ’ s consent will be null and void and will afford the non-assigning
party the right to immediately cancel and terminate this Agreement.

fields.value: No stated monetary cap; upon termination, consequential, exemplary, special, incidental and punitive damages are excluded.

quotes.text:
Upon termination of this Agreement, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL,
EXEMPLARY, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, EVEN IF IT HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH
DAMAGES, WHICH ARE RELATED TO THE AGREEMENT OR ITS BREACH.

ambiguities: Clause 2(b) is a damages exclusion and does not state an aggregate or monetary ceiling on liability.
Clause 2(b) is phrased as applying “Upon termination of this Agreement,” so its application outside termination is not stated.

fields.value: Torvec has primary sponsorship rights for all Vendor participation efforts in listed race events and the sole right to disapprove drivers; Vendor warrants no other person/entity has exclusive automotive sponsor rights for those activities/events. Trademark license rights are non-exclusive.

quotes.text:
During the Term of this Agreement, Torvec shall be entitled to the following sponsorship benefits:
a) Primary sponsorship rights to all of Vendor ’ s participation efforts in the above race events.
b) The right to specify and approve all team sponsorship identification markings, logos, graphics, etc. for vehicle livery, team
equipment and uniforms.
c) Sole right to disapprove any driver selected by Vendor for any reason. The driver for these events will be John Heinricy.

Vendor represents and warrants to Torvec the following: (i) it has the authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform hereunder in
accordance with its provisions; (ii) no other person or entity has the right to be the exclusive automotive sponsor of the activities and the events
set forth in this Agreement; and (iii) it will perform its obligations under this Agreement in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and
regulations.

Each party shall have a non-exclusive, royalty free, non-transferable license to use the name, logo, any item used in connection with that
name or logo, and the registered symbols and trademarks of the other party (the “ Trademarks ” ) only for the purposes set forth in this Agreement.

ambiguities: Clause 4(a) grants “Primary sponsorship rights” but does not expressly state that Torvec is the exclusive automotive sponsor or that other non-primary sponsors are barred.
Clause 9(ii) is framed as Vendor's representation about third-party rights, not as a separate affirmative exclusivity grant.

payments.description: Torvec payment/consideration to Phoenix Performance, LLC per Exhibit A; the Exhibit A schedule constitutes invoicing for events.
payments.conditionNote: The supplied text references Exhibit A for the payment schedule, amounts and due date(s), but Exhibit A is not included; Torvec may cancel participation at least two weeks before the due date(s).

payments.description: Torvec must provide Phoenix Performance, LLC the use of up to 2 Differential units for testing, evaluation and racing in the T-1 C5 Corvette.
payments.conditionNote: No delivery/use date is fixed, and the quantity is stated as “up to 2” units.

quotes.text:
Torvec will provide to Vendor the use of up to 2 Differential units to be used in the T-1 C5 Corvette for testing, evaluation and racing
purposes..

ambiguities: Clause 5(b) states “up to 2 Differential units” and does not fix the exact number or timing.
